name: PlainSpeak Accessible Geospatial Companion
author: lewisrowley

sections.description:
PlainSpeak Accessible Geospatial Companion is an accessibility-first framework for publishing GIS-backed status information in WordPress.

Core philosophy:

Question
→ Answer
→ Optional Exploration

Maps are optional supporting evidence rather than the primary user experience.

Intended Data Model

PlainSpeak Accessible Geospatial Companion is designed for datasets that have already been summarized into reporting metrics.

Typical examples include:

  • Miles of infrastructure by status
  • Projects by phase
  • Assets by condition
  • Counts by category

PlainSpeak presents these summarized values in an accessible, plain-language format and may optionally link to interactive applications for additional exploration.

PlainSpeak is not intended to replace dashboards, reporting systems, or ad-hoc analysis of detailed operational records.

Features

  • Accessibility-first results
  • Compatible with public ArcGIS REST Feature Services
  • Detail-area and rollup-area summary views
  • Static preview images
  • Optional link to explore data interactively
  • Keyboard and screen reader support
  • Theme-aware typography
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress Admin, navigate to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for “PlainSpeak Accessible Geospatial Companion”.
  3. Install and activate the plugin.

Alternatively:

  1. Download the plugin zip file.
  2. In WordPress Admin, navigate to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  3. Upload the zip file and activate the plugin.

After activation:

  1. Configure your data source settings.
  2. Add the PlainSpeak shortcode to a page.
  3. Test your detail-area and rollup-area reports.
sections.faq:
Does this require ArcGIS Online?

No. PlainSpeak Accessible Geospatial Companion is designed for public ArcGIS REST Feature Services. It has been developed and tested primarily with ArcGIS REST Feature Services and is expected to work with compatible ArcGIS Enterprise REST Feature Services.

Are maps required?

No. PlainSpeak Accessible Geospatial Companion presents answers and summary information directly on the page. Interactive maps, applications, and other data exploration tools can be provided as optional resources.

  • Preview image support.
  • Optional interactive data exploration links.
  • Theme-aware typography.
  • Accessibility improvements and review-results workflow.
